description: Ministry of Justice - The Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003 - Order under Sections 2, 3 and 8
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order issued by the Minister of Justice under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003. It establishes legal regulations regarding mediation procedures, specifies categories of financial disputes subject to mediation, defines monetary limits for such disputes, and designates special mediation board areas. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
